explication: Codex Security is a CLI and TypeScript SDK for repository security analysis, with a findings service, an MCP app, and a GitHub Action. The principal workflow scopes a repository scan, analyzes it, validates findings, and produces reports or patches; users can also draft policies, export threat models, and publish findings for review. The graph preserves documented capabilities and sampled integration points. Several scan and artifact internals are represented by their source directories because their implementation was not excerpted.
